messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++0x code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <cstdio>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <cstring>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

long long v;
long long cand[17];

int rec(int ind, long long val) {
	val = abs(val);
	if (ind == 0) {
		return val;
	}
	int a1 = val / cand[ind];
	int a2 = a1+1;
	return min(a1*(ind+1) + rec(ind-1, val-a1*cand[ind]), a2*(ind+1) + rec(ind-1, val-a2*cand[ind]));
}

int main(){
	scanf("%lld",&v);
	cand[0] = 1;
	for(int i = 1; i < 17; i++) {
		cand[i] = cand[i-1]*10 + 1;
	}
	printf("%d\n", rec(16, v));
	return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
